id: title:gantoine:stop semgrep general timing out on every pr

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a CI security scan workflow for shared dependencies, potentially improving supply chain security and false positive reduction.
review.reason: Adds a semgrep-general workflow job, its configuration, and its dependency on a previous oversized-filter step. This is a CI/CD maintenance and security scanning improvement.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned based solely on the observed code changes. The actual benefit, such as the number of vulnerabilities caught or false positives avoided, is not demonstrated by the patch and cannot be inferred. The tier is assigned because the implementation and configuration are visible, not because the outcome is verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single workflow file change. No other PRs are supplied, so no relationship between unrelated PRs can be established. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new workflow job named semgrep-general, gated by a conditional output from a previous oversized-filter step, and extends the timeout for an existing semgrep-general job.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a CI security scan for the 'general' codebase, executed only when the oversized-filter step indicates the general category is present. This could help catch broader, non-language-specific or shared dependency vulnerabilities not covered by language-specific jobs.

observations.behavior: Defines the exclusion and inclusion rules for the semgrep-general scan, including broad exclusions and specific inclusions.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the scope of the general security scan, excluding CLI, common, EE, frontend, livestream, nodejs, posthog, products, rust, semgrep, and docs, while including everything else. This could help avoid false positives in shared or vendor-dependent code while retaining coverage for the remaining shared or generic dependencies.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional dependency and increases the timeout for the semgrep-general job, with a comment explaining the rationale.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the semgrep-general job dependent on the oversized-filter step and extends its timeout to prevent premature failure, potentially allowing the scan to complete successfully. This could help avoid false negatives caused by slow runners or long-running scans.
